preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Reporte Seguro'

update.column: SELECT CAST(l.external_id AS CHAR) AS `NO. CREDITO`, NULLIF(TRIM(c.firstname), '') AS `PRIMER NOMBRE`, NULLIF(TRIM(c.middlename), '') AS `SGUNDO NOMBRE`, NULLIF(TRIM(c.lastname), '') AS `PRIMER APELLIDO`, NULLIF(TRIM(c.secondlastname), '') AS `SEGUNDO APELLIDO`, NULLIF(TRIM(c.marriedlastname), '') AS `APELLIDO CASADA`, l.disbursedon_date AS `FECHA OTORGADO`, ROUND(COALESCE(l.principal_disbursed_derived, 0), 2) AS `MONTO OTORGADO`, ROUND(COALESCE(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 0), 2) AS `SALDO CAPITAL`, ROUND(COALESCE(l.interest_outstanding_derived, 0), 2) AS `INTERESES POR PAGAR`, ROUND(COALESCE(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) + COALESCE(l.interest_outstanding_derived, 0), 2) AS `SUMA ASEGURADA`, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19, 6)) AS `EXTRA PRIMA`, c.date_of_birth AS `FECHA NAC`, CASE WHEN gender.code_value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN UPPER(TRIM(gender.code_value)) IN ('F', 'FEMALE', 'FEMENINO', 'MUJER') OR UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%FEM%' OR UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%MUJ%' THEN 'Femenino' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(gender.code_value)) IN ('M', 'MALE', 'MASCULINO', 'HOMBRE') OR UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%MASC%' OR UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%HOMB%' OR UPPER(TRIM(gender.code_value)) = 'MALE' OR UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE 'OPTION.MALE%' THEN 'Masculino' ELSE NULL END AS `SEXO`, NULLIF(TRIM(dp.nacionalidad), '') AS `NACIONALIDAD`, TRIM(COALESCE( ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = c.id AND UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%DUI%' LIMIT 1 ), CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(dp.tipo_documento_identificacion, '')) LIKE '%DUI%' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(dp.numero_documento_identificacion), '') ELSE NULL END )) AS `DUI`, ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = c.id AND ( UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%PASSPORT%' OR UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%PASAPORTE%' ) LIMIT 1 ) AS `PASAPORTE`, ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = c.id AND ( UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%RESIDENT%' OR UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%CARN%' OR UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%RESIDENTE%' ) LIMIT 1 ) AS `CARNE RESIDENTE`, TRIM(COALESCE( ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = c.id AND UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%NIT%' LIMIT 1 ), CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(dp.tipo_documento_identificacion, '')) LIKE '%NIT%' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(dp.numero_documento_identificacion), '') ELSE NULL END )) AS `NIT (Persona Juridica)`, NULLIF(TRIM(c.mobile_no), '') AS `Telefono movil`, NULLIF(TRIM(dp.telefono_residencia), '') AS `Telefono fijo`, NULLIF(TRIM(c.email_address), '') AS `correo electronico`, NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(dp.direccion_domicilio, ''), CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' ')), '') AS `Domicilio` FROM m_loan l JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id LEFT JOIN credesal_client_datos_personales dp ON dp.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value gender ON gender.id = c.gender_cv_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_delinquency_tag_history dtag ON dtag.loan_id = l.id AND dtag.liftedon_date IS NULL WHERE l.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL AND l.disbursedon_date <= '${endDate}' AND COALESCE(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) > 0 AND ('${loanProductId}' = '-1' OR FIND_IN_SET(l.product_id, '${loanProductId}')) AND ('${loanStatusId}' = '-1' OR FIND_IN_SET(l.loan_status_id, '${loanStatusId}')) AND ('${delinquencyRangeId}' = '-1' OR FIND_IN_SET(dtag.delinquency_range_id, '${delinquencyRangeId}')) ORDER BY l.disbursedon_date DESC, l.external_id
